Meta.title: Tesla Explorer
Meta.description: AI-planned leisure routes for Tesla drivers exploring the USA — time, charge, and curiosity.

Home.tagline: Plan the drive. Find the place.
Home.pitch: After work or on a weekend: chat with your route co-pilot from home or the office, approve a plan, then watch the 3D drive with place videos.

Onboarding.title: Create your profile
Onboarding.intro: Save your home and work addresses, who rides with you, kids, and which Tesla you drive. Battery is asked when you plan a trip.
Onboarding.addressSearchUnavailable: Address search needs a Mapbox token — you can still type the full address.
Onboarding.aboutMePlaceholder: Age vibe, energy, what makes a great evening drive
Onboarding.interestsPlaceholder: Food you like, places you enjoy, things to avoid
Onboarding.errorGeneric: Check the form and try again.
Onboarding.errorSave: Could not save your profile. Try again.
Onboarding.errorUnauthorized: Sign in again to save your profile.

Auth.signInIntro: Continue with Google to save your profile and routes.

Dashboard.title: Plan a drive
Dashboard.intro: This is your cabinet. Chat with your co-pilot — it already knows your car, home, and crew.
Dashboard.assistantCue: Say what you want from the drive. When the plan is ready you open the 3D map, approve, and Play drive with place videos.
Dashboard.addressSearchUnavailable: Address search needs a Mapbox token — type the full address.
Dashboard.promptPlaceholder: e.g. from office home for the kids, then a calm loop with dinner
Dashboard.chatPlaceholder: e.g. surprise me — tasty food and a walk with preschoolers
Dashboard.emptyProposed: No open proposals — chat above to craft one.
Dashboard.errorGeneric: Check the form and try again.
Dashboard.errorUnauthorized: Sign in again to plan a route.
Dashboard.errorNoProfile: Add home and work addresses in your profile first.
Dashboard.errorAi: Could not reach the route planner. Try again.
Dashboard.errorParse: The planner returned an unexpected answer. Try again.
Dashboard.errorSave: Could not save the route. Try again.

RouteDetail.mapMissingToken: Add NEXT_PUBLIC_MAPBOX_TOKEN to show the map.
RouteDetail.mapNoCoordinates: This plan has no map coordinates yet — adjust or re-propose with place pins.
RouteDetail.decisionIntro: Approve to save it, ask for changes, or decline.
RouteDetail.adjustNotesPlaceholder: e.g. skip the mall, add a charge stop, finish closer to home
RouteDetail.feedbackIntro: Ratings and notes improve the next plan — only for approved routes.
RouteDetail.impressionsPlaceholder: What stood out on this drive?
RouteDetail.preferencesPlaceholder: What should we lean into or avoid?
RouteDetail.saved: Saved — next plans will use this.
RouteDetail.errorGeneric: Check the form and try again.
RouteDetail.errorUnauthorized: Sign in again to save feedback.
RouteDetail.errorNotApproved: Approve the route before rating it.
